name: TALOS
description: Talos is new: a hot-rod head with an aluminium diamond-plate front, rivets, a chrome exhaust grille with the power tubes glowing behind it, and flames licking out of both ends. It runs the Dual Rectifier 2025 pack. The four rhythm captures rise in gain, and the fifth was captured with a TS808 in front, so that one sits behind the BOOST button.
